filing.title: File a Claim
filing.description: Submit evidence for your insurance claim.

updates.underReview: Your claim is under review by the DAO.
updates.payoutSent: Payout of {amount} XLM has been sent to your wallet.

appeal.modalDescription: Review the appeal rules before submitting your appeal for claim #{claimId}.
appeal.rule1Detail: You can only appeal this decision once.
appeal.rule2Detail: A higher percentage of voters must participate for the appeal to be valid.
appeal.rule3Detail: A fresh voting period will open, allowing all eligible voters to cast their vote again.
appeal.rule4Detail: The outcome of the appeal vote is final and cannot be appealed again.
appeal.notifyLabel: Notify me when this appeal resolves
appeal.notifyDesc: Receive a push/email notification when the appeal vote concludes, so you don't have to check back manually.
appeal.warningText: Submitting an appeal will require you to sign a transaction with your wallet. Make sure you understand the appeal rules before proceeding.
appeal.walletMismatchError: Wallet address changed since the modal was opened. Please close and try again.
